assistant_settings_bot_name_ck.name: assistant_settings_bot_name_ck
assistant_settings_bot_name_ck.value: "assistant_settings"."bot_name" is null or (char_length("assistant_settings"."bot_name") between 1 and 30 and "assistant_settings"."bot_name" !~ '[0-9]' and btrim("assistant_settings"."bot_name") = "assistant_settings"."bot_name")

assistant_settings_texts_ck.name: assistant_settings_texts_ck
assistant_settings_texts_ck.value: ("assistant_settings"."greeting_en" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."greeting_en") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."greeting_en") <= 200)) and ("assistant_settings"."greeting_zh" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."greeting_zh") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."greeting_zh") <= 200)) and ("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_en" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_en") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_en") <= 200)) and ("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_zh" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_zh") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."disclosure_note_zh") <= 200)) and ("assistant_settings"."after_hours_en" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."after_hours_en") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."after_hours_en") <= 300)) and ("assistant_settings"."after_hours_zh" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."after_hours_zh") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."after_hours_zh") <= 300)) and ("assistant_settings"."fallback_en" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."fallback_en") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."fallback_en") <= 300)) and ("assistant_settings"."fallback_zh" is null or (btrim("assistant_settings"."fallback_zh") <> '' and char_length("assistant_settings"."fallback_zh") <= 300))

facts_provenance_ck.name: facts_provenance_ck
facts_provenance_ck.value: "facts"."source_id" is null or ("facts"."provenance" is not null and "facts"."confidence" between 0 and 1)

facts_gst_ck.name: facts_gst_ck
facts_gst_ck.value: ("facts"."gst_treatment" is null or "facts"."gst_treatment" in ('inclusive', 'exclusive', 'unknown')) and (("facts"."type" = 'product' and "facts"."gst_treatment" is not null) or ("facts"."type" in ('faq', 'policy') and "facts"."gst_treatment" is null) or ("facts"."type" = 'promotion' and ("facts"."value" ? 'priceCents') = ("facts"."gst_treatment" is not null)))

facts_validity_ck.name: facts_validity_ck
facts_validity_ck.value: ("facts"."type" <> 'promotion' or "facts"."valid_until" is not null) and ("facts"."valid_from" is null or "facts"."valid_until" is null or "facts"."valid_from" < "facts"."valid_until")

kb_source_pages_reason_ck.name: kb_source_pages_reason_ck
kb_source_pages_reason_ck.value: ("kb_source_pages"."status" = 'included') = ("kb_source_pages"."reason" is null) and ("kb_source_pages"."reason" is null or "kb_source_pages"."reason" in ('robots', 'off_domain_redirect', 'not_html', 'duplicate', 'timeout', 'http_error', 'blocked_address', 'load_error', 'plan_limit', 'no_text', 'page_limit', 'ocr_limit', 'empty_row', 'no_name', 'no_price', 'bad_price', 'not_sgd', 'bad_stock', 'too_long'))

kb_sources_website_ck.name: kb_sources_website_ck
kb_sources_website_ck.value: "kb_sources"."kind" <> 'website' or ("kb_sources"."url" is not null and "kb_sources"."domain" is not null and "kb_sources"."page_limit" is not null and "kb_sources"."attested_by" is not null and "kb_sources"."attested_at" is not null)

kb_sources_file_ck.name: kb_sources_file_ck
kb_sources_file_ck.value: "kb_sources"."kind" not in ('file', 'spreadsheet', 'chat') or ("kb_sources"."upload_key" is not null and "kb_sources"."file_size" > 0)

kb_sources_failure_ck.name: kb_sources_failure_ck
kb_sources_failure_ck.value: ("kb_sources"."status" = 'failed') = ("kb_sources"."failure" is not null) and ("kb_sources"."failure" is null or "kb_sources"."failure" in ('no_pages', 'site_unreachable', 'extraction_unavailable', 'internal', 'upload_missing', 'too_large', 'unsupported_type', 'encrypted', 'malware', 'scan_unavailable', 'unreadable', 'no_text', 'no_rows', 'no_valid_rows', 'chat_format', 'business_not_found'))

kb_sources_counts_ck.name: kb_sources_counts_ck
kb_sources_counts_ck.value: ("kb_sources"."page_limit" is null or "kb_sources"."page_limit" > 0) and "kb_sources"."attempt" >= 1 and least("kb_sources"."pages_found", "kb_sources"."pages_included", "kb_sources"."pages_excluded", "kb_sources"."pages_failed", "kb_sources"."pages_skipped", "kb_sources"."pages_extracted", "kb_sources"."facts_count", "kb_sources"."ocr_pages") >= 0

messages_notice_ck.name: messages_notice_ck
messages_notice_ck.value: ("messages"."notice" is null) = ("messages"."notice_kind" is null) and ("messages"."notice_kind" is null or "messages"."notice_kind" in ('after_hours', 'chat_ended'))
